g.title: Inspects persisted Decision Bundles in PostgreSQL; runs the eval suite to review retrieval quality, faithfulness, and decision consistency.
LLM inference for the policy gate.
Generates synthetic LoginEvent streams across 8 attack and benign scenarios; publishes to Redis Streams. Python 3.11 CLI, generator/.
Reads Redis Streams; validates LoginEvent schema, enforces bounded lateness, deduplicates. Routes failures to DLQ. Async event path. app/ingestion/.
HTTP entry point: accepts LoginEvent, runs Feature Engine → Scorer → Assembler, submits Observation to DecisionLedger pipeline, returns DecisionResponse. FastAPI, app/.

Receives Observation (ReasonerContext + GateContext). Three-stage hybrid RAG → LLM policy gate → deterministic enforcement → audit bundle. app/retrieval + app/policy_gate + app/enforcement + app/audit.
pgvector HNSW index for dense policy retrieval (384-dim, all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Audit store for Decision Bundles. PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector.
BM25 sparse index over the policy corpus with jurisdiction and version filters. Elasticsearch 8.13.
Offline CLI: chunks policy documents, embeds with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, bulk-inserts into pgvector and Elasticsearch. app/retrieval/.
5-dimension eval: retrieval quality, faithfulness, decision consistency, citation accuracy, adversarial robustness. eval/.
